question: To tell the truth, Elsa’s exit from the story was anticlimactic. I thought it would have been nice to have her hang on a little longer, and threaten Subaru’s group a few more times. I’m not sure it’s really a good thing to always be getting rid of old characters and focusing on new characters, but as long as Rem comes back, nothing else really matters, so please trade out characters as much as you like, Cat-sensei.
answer: Look, if the new characters were taken out quickly, you’d ask “Why did you even add them to the story!?”. Look at Boiled Egg-sensei. Don’t worry too much about the details!
